description: This class includes the repair and maintenance of industrial machinery and equipment.
includes: repair and maintenance of engines and turbines (except aircraft, vehicle and cycle engines)
repair and maintenance of fluid power equipment (pumps, compressors, hydraulic/pneumatic systems)
repair and maintenance of lifting and handling equipment: cranes, hoists, conveyors
repair and maintenance of office machinery: photocopiers, fax machines (non-electronic)
repair and maintenance of machine tools
repair and maintenance of mining and quarrying machinery
repair and maintenance of food, beverage and tobacco processing machinery
repair and maintenance of textile, apparel and leather production machinery
repair and maintenance of agricultural tractors and other agricultural machinery
repair and maintenance of other general-purpose and special-purpose machinery
excludes: repair of computers and peripheral equipment, see 9511
repair and maintenance of motor vehicles, see 4520
